scope: Independent bounded adversarial review of the pure in-memory CODE Git object kernel after Builder handoff

review_phases.purpose: Bind the handed-off source root, exact candidate head/tree, three-path allowlist, byte-exact fixture copy, and stopped source writes before observations.
checks: handoff status and fields
candidate path scope
fixture bytes and hash
module/test/fixture presence
no extra candidate files

review_phases.purpose: Verify helper validation order and immutable profile behavior before any frame construction or hashing.
checks: frame_git_object and git_object_ids exact builtin types
unsupported format/type pointers and ten-code surface
body cap at 8388608 before hash/frame
MappingProxyType profile exact order/values and per-call lowered copy isolation
strict bool rejection for limits and executable flags

review_phases.purpose: Exercise exact container shape, count and declared-size precedence before body lookup/hash/parsing.
checks: target/object/body mapping count caps before iteration
declared per-object and aggregate caps before body lookup
actual size caps before size mismatch and hashes
extra body keys before missing keys
strict list/dict/str/bytes/int/bool admission

review_phases.purpose: Use independently hash-valid mutated object bodies to isolate commit/tree grammar refusals.
checks: root/header mismatch
CR/NUL/TAB/malformed continuation/duplicate tree-parent headers
header byte and line caps
tree truncation, duplicate names, bad mode, bad order, invalid names
hash-valid malformed objects still reach COMMIT_INVALID or TREE_INVALID

review_phases.purpose: Validate required/missing/wrong-type/unused closure and exact target outcomes against both fixture formats.
checks: fixture all_safe and shared_subtree success
missing body versus missing filename
required undeclared tree/blob OBJECT_UNAVAILABLE
declared wrong type OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH
extra/unused object and consumed-set mismatch
executable opt-in/refusal, symlink, gitlink, directory, non-directory intermediate
missing stopped_at preserves attempted ASCII name_hex

review_phases.purpose: Check deterministic primitive-only success output, input ownership, and no I/O/network/subprocess/resource-loader activity.
checks: exact top-level/nested key order and list order
repeat-call equality and no bytes/custom objects/floats in result
deep input snapshots unchanged
guard filesystem/socket/subprocess/resource entry points for success and refusal
no partial proof on hard failure

stop_and_report: Do not run until exact candidate handoff status is supplied.
Do not rewrite candidate source, tests, fixture, branch, or Git history.
If a failure occurs, preserve the first bounded failure and report code/details, phase, and candidate head.
Do not convert preparation-plan status into implementation acceptance.
